page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.8xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose instance within the Enhanced family, powered by a KVM hypervisor. The instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor clocked at a baseline of 2.7 GHz. System memory totals 128.0 GB, providing an exact ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, aligning with standard general-purpose computing profiles.

Hardware architecture for the ecs.g8ise.8xlarge includes no integrated GPUs and comes without onboard local storage, necessitating external network-attached block storage for persistent disk operations. Network connectivity is supported by a 20 Gbps baseline bandwidth allocation, though complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-memory configuration delivers balanced processing capacity and memory headroom for distributed enterprise applications. Because local disk I/O relies entirely on remote storage, architectures must account for network storage latency and throughput. It is technically appropriate for multi-tier web applications, enterprise ERP backends, mid-sized database instances, and general containerized microservices.
